verdict.rationale: Supabase is a hosted data platform with an integrated AI Assistant, so whether customer data is used for AI training is a fair privacy question. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a training opt-out or a no-training commitment. Self-hosting and region selection for data residency are adjacent controls or user-side workarounds and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
